## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] VisuaLeaf reports that a matching aggregation failed with 'operation exceeded time limit' under a stored 1 ms budget, without command maxTimeMS, and succeeded after removing that setting; the test used MongoDB 9.0.2 and FCV 9.0. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-09) — https://visualeaf.com/blog/mongodb-9-0-whats-new/ · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0)

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Choose a shape budget using realistic parameter values: structurally matching queries can perform very different amounts of work, and a timeout stops excess work rather than accelerating execution. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-09) — https://visualeaf.com/blog/mongodb-9-0-whats-new/ · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0)

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB 9.0 introduces per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs through setQuerySettings; both require FCV 9.0 or later. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/9.0.md · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0) · also: https://www.nosqlbooster.com/blog/announcing-nosqlbooster-11-2/
- [statement] A stored maxTimeMS takes precedence over command-level maxTimeMS, so it can tighten or loosen that server-side execution budget. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0) · also: https://visualeaf.com/blog/mongodb-9-0-whats-new/
- [statement] Setting per-shape maxTimeMS to 0 clears the override; command-level maxTimeMS and defaultMaxTimeMS then govern timeout selection. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0)
- [statement] queryKnobs overrides supported internal parameters for matching shapes across the cluster; the per-shape value takes precedence over the instance parameter and compiled default. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0) · also: https://www.nosqlbooster.com/blog/announcing-nosqlbooster-11-2/
- [statement] queryKnobs updates merge by knob: omitted knobs remain, an empty document does nothing, and null removes one knob. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0) · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-123662
- [statement] Knob validation rejects unknown or ineligible names, wrong types, invalid enums, out-of-range values, and knobs requiring a newer FCV. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0) · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-128267, https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-121945
- [statement] Knobs participate in hashed query settings and the plan-cache key; changing a knob value produces a fresh key. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0)
- [statement] FCV downgrade removes incompatible knobs; upgrading again does not restore them. Reapply the removed settings explicitly. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setQuerySettings.md · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0)
- [statement] The reviewed master-branch QuerySettingsService interface exempts explain execution from the stored maxTimeMS while still reporting it; use an actual execution to test enforcement. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/query/query_settings/query_settings_service.h · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0)
- [statement] NoSQLBooster 11.2 documents stored maxTimeMS together with queryKnobs: { noTableScan: true }, providing an independent client-tool adoption example. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-26) — https://www.nosqlbooster.com/blog/announcing-nosqlbooster-11-2/ · keywords: Per-shape maxTimeMS and queryKnobs (9.0)
